name: Known By Many Names
description:
You have a true name. It is your greatest secret and your greatest weakness. You shield yourself with many other names.

Someone who knows your true name always rolls favored when acting upon you, regardless of whether they intend to help or harm you. If any creature utters your true name, you cannot cause them harm until the next sunset.

Describe how this bond manifests.

The more names you attach to yourself in the world - obscuring your true name - the more powerful you become. These names can be personal names, titles, or other appellations given to you by yourself or by others, but they only grant you power if they are used by others with regularity, whether in addressing you directly or referring to you in conversation, rumors or tales. The GM has full discretion to determine the number of names that are being used regularly in this way at any given time throughout the world.

These names grant you a pool of +1d bonuses that you may apply at-will to skill checks you make. The number of +1d bonuses is equal to the number of names you are known by and is replenished every sunset.

Describe how you wield the power of names.
